title: Explore clearer documentation and a combined RomM deployment
description: A concise project overview links to installation, verification, storage, backup, and troubleshooting guides. An optional Docker Compose example runs ROM Checker and RomM together with a dedicated export folder and step-by-step API token setup.
upgrade: Existing deployments are unchanged. The combined example is intended for a new stack; back up and explicitly migrate existing exports before changing their mount.
limitations: The example pins RomM 5.4.1. Deployment configuration and upstream token instructions have been reviewed, but a live end-to-end RomM compatibility test remains outstanding.
